Root cause proven live 2026-09-24: RuStore's distributor app is killed by MIUI, so pushes only arrive when RuStore is relaunched; server + RuStore API are healthy (200). Decision by author: option A. Needs a new ADR amending adr/0179/0180. Architecture already additive: IPushSender port + operator_devices.provider exist. See docs/backlog/26-100-*.md.
